creator: Alexander Terp
description: A join routed to another machine's group renames the caller locally before the home answers, so a refusal from the home leaves the caller's name switched. A join to a group kept here checks the policy first since 2026-10-05. Fixing the routed case means asking the home before renaming; a replica's copy of the policy can be stale, so it cannot decide alone.
title: A refused join to a group kept elsewhere still renames the caller
